description: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.
A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
Its earthen skin is reasonably hard—it has no problem repelling a Starly's pecking, at least.
Its body, composed of refuse, blends in to the scenery so much as to be inconspicuous. This seems to be the perfect way for the Pokémon to evade the detection of predators.
Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light, and its tiny body transforms. I took a whiff of the flower myself, but alas, my body remained unchanged.
Giratina loses its legs upon changing into this form. I believe this Pokémon must hail from a world where the heavens and the earth are as one, though I have no way of proving it.
This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It has a flair for manipulating flames.
This Rotom has possessed a washing machine that uses a special motor. It blasts out water to intimidate opponents.
This Rotom has possessed a refrigerator that uses a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.
This Rotom has possessed an electric fan that uses a special motor. It sends its enemies flying with gusts of wind.
This Rotom has possessed a lawn mower that uses a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.
Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!
This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.
This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!
The power of its jaws is immense—enough to leave teeth marks in iron sheets. Its personality is also extremely vicious.
Now that it has reclaimed a long-forgotten song, Meloetta captivates everyone with its enchanting dance steps.
An example of what is known as a “form change,” though I suspect this strange avian guise to be Tornadus's true form. Tornadus has been sighted crossing the ocean while in this form.
Quick as a flash, it materializes out of nowhere. It pulverizes foes into nothingness with showers of devastatingly powerful lightning bolts launched from the string of orbs on its tail.
Landorus soars through the sky in this form, bestowing plentiful harvests upon the land and earning the people's reverence. It can traverse the whole of Hisui in a mere couple of hours.
The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.*
It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future.*
Keldeo's magnificent horn is proof of its resolve. Its allies provided guidance, and their hopes became Keldeo's tricolored plume of feathers.
Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.
This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade.
Small Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where few lost souls lingered.
Large Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where many lost souls lingered.
Massive Pumpkaboo are said to be the product of areas where a great number of lost souls lingered.
A small-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a small-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.
A large-sized Pumpkaboo evolves into a large-sized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.
A supersized Pumpkaboo evolves into a supersized Gourgeist. Its bodily proportions also get passed on to its descendants.
In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.
The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and creates intense blue flames.
Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet.
The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.
Alakazam has traded away its muscles, unleashing its true power. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.
It can pass through other dimensions and appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.
Its child has grown rapidly, thanks to the energy of Mega Evolution. Mother and child show off their harmonious teamwork in battle.
After Mega Evolution, it becomes able to fly. Perhaps because it's so happy, it rarely touches the ground.
It jets water from the orifices on its sides, streaking above the water surface at supersonic speed.
Parts of its body have become stone. Some scholars claim that this is Aerodactyl's true appearance.
Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint 100 meters in two seconds flat!
Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.
Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.
Due to the effects of Mega Evolution, its pincers have taken on a more diabolical form, ripping anything they pinch to shreds.
It can grip things with its two horns and lift 500 times its own body weight.
Houndoom's entire body generates heat when it Mega Evolves. Its intense, fiery breath turns its opponents to charcoal.
The effects of Mega Evolution make it more ferocious than ever. It's unclear whether it can even hear its Trainer's orders.
Boiling-hot blood courses through its entire body, doubling the sharpness of its moves. It subdues opponents in the blink of an eye.
When it opens the red plate on its chest and unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power is released.
Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.
Energy from Mega Evolution has turned the iron inside this Pokémon into steel armor that covers Mega Aggron's whole body.
Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice to defeat its enemies.
Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous amount of electricity, but it's too much for Manectric to fully control.
Mega Evolution increases its vindictiveness, and the cursing power that was held back by its zipper comes spilling out.
When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.
Its disposition is more vicious than before its Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents up with the scythes on both arms.
Black streaks all over its body show where its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution intermingled and raced through it.
The buds on its back have sprouted into impressive icicles that can whip up massive blizzards of −22 degrees Fahrenheit.
This rare Floette holds a plant that died out in ancient times. The Pokémon is said to harbor an incredible power.
Both its flying capabilities and its attack power have increased. It scatters transparent down to confuse its enemies.
It flies at speeds exceeding Mach 4. It is among the top tier of all Pokémon in terms of aerial combat capability.
The water within its body further strengthens its already enlarged muscles, using the same principles as a hydraulic pump.
The seeds on its back are filled with energy from Mega Evolution. The Pokémon detonates these seeds to launch the tip of its tail.
The jewel from its chest, which has grown gigantic due to the effects of Mega Evolution, can turn back any attack.
Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could melt it. But it's strong enough that just a few strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.
It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer. Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its enemies and a cape to protect its body.
Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall into a deep sleep.
The spines sprouting from its head are transformed fangs. If they're injured or broken off, the spines will regenerate countless times.
When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There is virtually no change in Slowpoke.
To protect itself from opponents' attacks, it uses magnetism to control pieces of its hard outer shell that have flaked off.
With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.
When it spews stupendously cold air from its broken mouth, the entire area around it gets whited out.
This Pokémon is also known as the Royal Pink Princess. The dazzling, sparkling diamond on its forehead is a whopping 2,000 carats.
This form results from one Metagross, one Metang, and two Beldum linking up.
Kyogre reverted to this state via the Blue Orb, which contains the energy of the primordial world. Kyogre's body resembles seawater.
This is Groudon's true form, restored using the Red Orb. Energy spills from its body in the form of magma.
A shooting star streaking across the night sky may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully after a meteoroid.
This is Hoopa's true form, in which it has regained its sealed powers. The hole in its chest is said to connect to another dimension.
When this Pokémon's rage reaches a boiling point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back erupts violently, spewing molten lava.
It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.
To streamline itself for flight, it pulls its forelegs into its shell. Salamence flies at high speeds even when faced with complex topographical features.
Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.
Its whiskers provide it with a keen sense of smell, enabling it to pick up the scent of hidden food and locate it instantly.
It makes its Rattata underlings gather food for it, dining solely on the most nutritious and delicious fare.
This Pikachu wears its partner's cap—proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across many different regions.
It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.
An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.
A long, long time ago, it lived in the desert. With its sharp claws fully extended, it can run right up an iceberg without slipping.
In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.
It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.
Its golden whiskers function as sensors. It pokes them out of its burrow to monitor its surroundings.
Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very fast, but it has the power to dig through even the hardest bedrock.
It's fickle, selfish, and easily bored. This species is very popular with certain Trainers-ones who prefer fulfilling others' needs over their own.
Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.
If you step on a Geodude sleeping on the ground, you’ll hear a zapping sound and feel a tingling shock throughout your entire body.
Graveler's entire body is electrically charged due to the stones it likes to eat. It is a very quick-tempered Pokémon.
It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn’t fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.
Alolan Grimer will gladly gobble up any kind of trash, making it a widely used and popular Pokémon at garbage disposal facilities.
What look like fangs and claws are actually crystallized poison that will afflict you at a mere touch, so don’t get too close.
As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.
It has transformed the spirit of its dear departed mother into flames, and tonight it will once again dance in mourning of others of its kind.
It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.
The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.
This form of Oricorio has sipped pink nectar. It elevates its mind with the gentle steps of its dance, then unleashes its psychic energy.
The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.
This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.
When facing tough opponents, they get into formation. But if they get wounded in battle, they'll scatter and become solitary again.
Mimikyu is sad that it may be exposed for what it really is. It will take revenge on whoever broke the neck of its disguise-no forgiveness.
This Magearna looks as it did at the time of its invention. Its magnificent ornamentation delighted the king's daughter.
This Pikachu wears its partner's cap—proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed as the two overcame many hardships together.
These Pokémon have both calm and ferocious qualities. It's said that this form of Lycanroc is the most troublesome to raise.
Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo. It siphons away its host's limitless energy, exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage.*
When Necrozma latches on to Lunala, it becomes vicious, seeing enemies everywhere it looks. It will burn the world with lasers.*
The light pouring out from all over its body affects living things and nature, impacting them in various ways.
This Pikachu wears its partner's cap—proof of the strong bond Pikachu and its partner formed during adventures across the world.
Its unkempt beard is a vestige from living in cold climes. It fights dauntlessly using its steel claws.
This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.
Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.
Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke's diet.
A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.
Wielding a thick, heavy leek has strengthened its body. In battle, it bets everything on a single destructive blow.
Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.
It uses its tap-dancing steps to rapidly chill the surrounding area and form a splendid stage made of ice.
Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires Freezing Glare that can Freeze opponents as if they had been frozen solid.
One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.
The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.
A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.
Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.
Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.
This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.
The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.
Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.
A cursed clay slab and a departed spirit have become bound together. This Pokémon swings its slab around with malicious intent.
Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.
Cramorant takes advantage of Arrokuda's frantic thrashing to help spit Arrokuda out at high speed.
With a Pikachu stuck in its throat, Cramorant can use Pikachu's prickling electricity to give its opponents a shock.
On its chest is an electricity-generating organ. A sound like that of a bass guitar echoes all around while this organ produces electricity.
Contrary to its looks, Eiscue is a poor swimmer. It creates ice balls at the tip of its single hair to lure prey in and fish them up.
These Pokémon are highly intelligent. They touch horns with their fellow Indeedee to share information with one another.
Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.
Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.
Now that it's equipped with its shield, it can shrug off impressive blows, including the attacks of Dynamax Pokémon.
Infinite amounts of energy pour from this Pokémon's enlarged core, warping the surrounding space-time.
This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.
This Zarude's special strength stems from its love and care for an orphaned human child that the Pokémon has raised since the child's infancy.
It's said that this Pokémon once moved a large forest—and all the Pokémon living there—to a new location overnight.
Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
After this Pokémon has Gigantamaxed, its massive nose can utterly demolish large structures with a single smashing blow.
The hardness of its cells is exceptional, even among Steel types. It also has a body structure that's resistant to earthquakes.
They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
This Pokémon eats toxic minerals to build up poison within itself. Get jabbed by it, and you'll face three days and three nights of misery.
Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
The iron in Sliggoo's drinking water turned its shell metallic. The Pokémon doesn't come out of its shell on sunny days.
If anything bad happens to it, Goodra retreats into its shell and bounces around like a rubber ball, knocking down trees and boring into mountains.
With its icy jaw, it swiftly plows across snowy fields and mountains, in search of nutritious vegetables people have stored in the snow.
The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to Arceus. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.
It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia's strategy for gaining Arceus's powers.
Its ecology is starkly different from that of other Basculin, so theories that it's a totally different species have gained traction in recent years.
It can afflict a target with terrifying illusions that are under its control. The deeper the sadness in its friends' souls, the paler Basculegion becomes.
A different guise from its feminine humanoid form. From the clouds, it descends upon those who treat any form of life with disrespect and metes out wrathful, ruthless punishment.
This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.
People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.
It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.
It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.
This is a meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep things tidy. It shrouds itself in a floral aroma that soothes the Pokémon around it.
A recent study uncovered that the number of segments a Dudunsparce’s body has is determined by the Pokémon’s genes.
This hero of the ocean swims at a speed of 50 knots and saves drowning people and Pokémon.
The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.
Even if swallowed by a foe, Tatsugiri will try to make its escape through various means, such as by inflating its throat sac.
Tatsugiri assesses situations using its sharp intellect. If it determines there is no hope of winning, it flees as fast as it can.
Squawkabilly with blue plumage are the second most populous variety after their green counterparts, which they view as foes.
Squawkabilly with yellow plumage grew increasingly aggressive in order to be taken seriously by the more populous varieties.
This is the least populous variety of Squawkabilly. They don't like conflict, but when they have to fight, they do so valiantly and resolutely.
If it senses it's about to be found by a human or a Pokémon, Gimmighoul will turn invisible to protect itself, leaving only its coin visible.
This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
In this form, it draws on the power of water. It attacks unrelentingly with kicks and ivy strikes.
In this form, it draws on the power of fire. It spears its enemies with thorn-covered ivy.
In this form, it draws on the power of stone. Its body is rock-solid, protecting it from all manner of attacks.
The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move's energy and transfers it to Terapagos.
An old expedition journal describes the sight of this Pokémon buried in the depths of the earth as resembling a planet floating in space.
It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.
The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.
Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.
Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.
This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.
With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.
It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.
This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.
Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.
If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.
Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.
Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.
It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.
One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.
It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.
It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.
This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.
The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.
It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.
It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.
It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.
Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.
In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.
Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.
Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.
It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.
It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.
It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.
Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.
Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.
Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.
By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.
It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.
Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.
The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.
It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.
It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.
This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.
It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.
Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its "necktie" around to wallop its foes.
Glimmora's petals—now larger and separated from its main body—rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.
Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.
